name: hse-nz-au-skills
description: NZ/AU workplace health & safety Claude Agent Skills — one-step industry bundles built from a core pack plus hazard, plant and sector packs

plugins.name: hse-core
plugins.description: Start here. The hse-advisor orchestrator plus the cross-cutting specialists — critical risk and bow ties, energy-based safety, officer governance, NZ and AU duties, high-risk work licensing, investigation, SOPs, task analysis, plain language and prosecution learning.

plugins.name: hse-hazards
plugins.description: Subject-matter experts for the recurring fatal and serious-harm hazards — working at height, excavation, confined space, machinery, mobile plant and traffic, hazardous substances and asbestos, electrical, water, psychosocial risk, and violence and aggression.

plugins.name: hse-plant
plugins.description: Subject-matter experts for the equipment itself — cranes, lifting and rigging, forklifts, elevating work platforms, scaffolding and pressure equipment — each with its capacity or load calculator.

plugins.name: hse-sector-primary
plugins.description: Sector specialists for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and commercial fishing and aquaculture.

plugins.name: hse-sector-industrial
plugins.description: Sector specialists for construction, manufacturing, food and meat processing, and waste and recycling.

plugins.name: hse-sector-transport
plugins.description: Sector specialists for road transport and logistics, stevedoring, maritime and ports, and rail.

plugins.name: hse-sector-energy-resources
plugins.description: Sector specialists for electricity supply, geothermal, oil and gas, mining and quarrying, and drilling.

plugins.name: hse-sector-care-hospitality
plugins.description: Sector specialists for healthcare, aged and disability care, and hospitality.

plugins.name: hse-for-construction-industrial
plugins.description: One-step install for construction, manufacturing, food processing and waste — the core pack, hazard specialists, plant and lifting specialists, and the construction and industrial sector specialists.

plugins.name: hse-for-primary-industries
plugins.description: One-step install for farming, horticulture, forestry, and fishing and aquaculture — the core pack, hazard specialists and the primary-industry sector specialists.

plugins.name: hse-for-transport-ports-rail
plugins.description: One-step install for road transport and logistics, stevedoring, maritime and ports, and rail — the core pack, hazard specialists, plant and lifting specialists, and the transport sector specialists.

plugins.name: hse-for-energy-resources
plugins.description: One-step install for electricity supply, geothermal, oil and gas, mining and quarrying, and drilling — the core pack, hazard specialists, plant and lifting specialists, and the energy and resources sector specialists.

plugins.name: hse-for-care-hospitality
plugins.description: One-step install for healthcare, aged and disability care, and hospitality — the core pack, hazard specialists (including psychosocial risk and violence) and the care and hospitality sector specialists.

plugins.name: hse-everything
plugins.description: Every pack in one install — all 48 skills. Best on large-context models; on a 200k-context model this exceeds Claude's skill-listing budget, so the least-used skills list by name only. Prefer an industry bundle if one fits.
